parsed.post: Discarding latest experiment (0.8664) as it regressed from my best (0.8522). It seems the batch size reduction or learning rate stability is hit-or-miss. I'll revert to my best config and try adjusting the learning rate to 0.03 to see if a more conservative approach helps with the 262k batch size.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.03 to improve stability and potentially lower val_bpb on the current depth=6/batch=262k configuration.
